subject: ela
intro: Use context and word parts to pick the meaning.

items.prompt:
Read.

A 'predator' hunts other animals.

'Predator' means:
A) a plant
B) an animal that hunts others
C) a rock
items.answer: B) an animal that hunts others

steps: Defined in text. Key is B.
solution.answer: B) an animal that hunts others

items.prompt:
'Thermometer' (thermo = heat) measures:
A) distance
B) temperature
C) weight

Read.

The mixture became a liquid, or molten.

'Molten' means:
A) frozen
B) melted into liquid
C) solid

steps: Defined in text. Key is B.

items.prompt:
Read.

The hypothesis, a possible explanation to test, proved correct.

'Hypothesis' means:
A) a final answer
B) a testable guess
C) a tool

steps: Defined in text. Key is B.

items.prompt:
'Microscope' uses 'micro' (small) and 'scope' (to look). It is a tool to:
A) look at small things
B) measure heat
C) travel far

'Herbivore' is an animal that:
A) eats only plants
B) eats only meat
C) eats rocks

steps: Herbivore = plant eater. Key is A.

items.prompt:
'Invisible' uses 'in-' (not) and 'vis' (see). It means:
A) easy to see
B) not able to be seen
C) very bright
items.answer: B) not able to be seen

solution.answer: B) not able to be seen

items.prompt:
Read.

The gas was compressed, squeezed into a much smaller space.

'Compressed' means:
A) expanded
B) squeezed smaller
C) heated

steps: Defined in text. Key is B.
